scenario.description: An elementary principal must finalize one-day coverage for two classes whose teachers will be absent, including staff assignments and required supervision records, with input from the absent teachers' grade-level colleague and the staffing coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The teachers of classes 4A and 5B will both be absent next Wednesday.
shared_context.S2: The staff listed as available for coverage are instructional coach Ms. Patel, counselor Mr. Lewis, and substitute teacher Ms. Grant.
shared_context.S3: Ms. Brooks is responsible for approving the coverage plan and recording any required supervision or testing assignments.
shared_context.S4: The school follows a routine pre-approval check in which the grade-level team and staffing coordinator report relevant classroom or staffing information before coverage is finalized.

PF1.text: Class 5B's current behavior-support plan requires a CPI-trained adult to remain with the class for the entire school day; Ms. Patel is the only person on the available list with current CPI training. Mr. Shah confirmed the plan during this week's grade-level review, but the coverage request was submitted before that review.

PF2.text: Class 4A has a scheduled state reading assessment from 9:00 to 10:30 next Wednesday, and Mr. Lewis is the only available person authorized to proctor it. Ms. Ortega verified the authorization in the state testing portal this week, but the testing assignment has not yet been added to the coverage spreadsheet.

acceptance_conditions: Ms. Patel must cover class 5B for the full school day, given the CPI-trained adult requirement.
Mr. Lewis must proctor class 4A's state reading assessment from 9:00 to 10:30 next Wednesday.
Ms. Grant must cover class 4A outside the assessment block.
The settlement must include a commitment recording Ms. Patel's full-day assignment to class 5B with reference to the CPI-trained adult requirement or behavior-support plan.
The settlement must include a commitment recording Mr. Lewis as the assigned proctor for the class 4A state reading assessment from 9:00 to 10:30.

content_checks.C4: decisions['class_5B_full_day_staff'] == 'Ms. Patel' and any('Ms. Patel' in c['detail'] and '5B' in c['detail'] and ('CPI' in c['detail'] or 'behavior-support' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions['class_4A_assessment_proctor'] == 'Mr. Lewis' and any(('Mr. Lewis' in c['detail'] or 'Lewis' in c['detail']) and ('proctor' in c['detail'] or 'assessment' in c['detail'] or 'testing' in c['detail']) and ('4A' in c['detail'] or '9:00' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The 5B behavior-support plan changes the full-day assignment to Ms. Patel and requires the settlement to record her CPI-trained coverage for that class.

The 4A assessment schedule and proctor authorization change the 9:00-10:30 assignment to Mr. Lewis, leave Ms. Grant for non-assessment coverage, and require that specific testing assignment to be recorded.
